build_VqVaeXCiTAutoencoder: build a VQ-VAE autoencoder with XCiT attention for high-resolution image compression using a custom bottleneck operation
create_VqVaeXCiTConvEncoder: create a convolutional encoder with XCiT attention blocks that downsamples images to a latent embedding representation
create_VqvaeXCiTConvDecoder: create a convolutional decoder with XCiT attention blocks that reconstructs images from latent embeddings
create_ResnetBlock: create a residual block with configurable normalization type and optional dropout for the encoder or decoder
create_norm: create a normalization layer choosing between group normalization or channel normalization based on the specified type
